title: Round matchup
description: The game this round trades: the two teams and the pregame view of the home side, captured when the round opened. Reference data for the round rather than a reading to watch.

home_team.label: Home
home_team.description: The home side; the book quotes its win probability.

away_team.label: Away
away_team.description: The away side; its price is the complement of the home price.

pregame_home_prob.label: Pregame home win
pregame_home_prob.description: Gemini's price for the home side when the round opened, read as a probability; a round that opened after tipoff starts from even. The model starts from it all game.
